chars.AKRAM: AKRAM: a young Moroccan man of 27, medium height, short curly black hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black joggers and white sneakers
chars.REDOUANE: REDOUANE: a short young Moroccan man of 28, buzz cut, thin mustache, wearing a dark green bomber jacket over a grey t-shirt and blue jeans
chars.NORA: NORA: a young Moroccan woman of 26, long wavy auburn-dyed hair, big gold hoop earrings, wearing a red tracksuit jacket with white stripes, black leggings and chunky white sneakers
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young Moroccan woman wearing a pastel pink hijab and a light denim jacket

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: At the open door of a small modest apartment in El Jadida, NORA stands in the doorway arguing angrily with AKRAM, pointing at him, AKRAM rolls his eyes and holds the door half closed; REDOUANE watches awkwardly from the sofa behind with a comic embarrassed face. Both faces clearly visible, tense funny moment.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a small Moroccan living room with a cheap sofa, AKRAM slumps on the sofa looking exhausted and annoyed, holding up his ringing smartphone toward REDOUANE as if to say 'again!', REDOUANE sitting next to him raises his eyebrows, amused.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: NORA sits on a rooftop terrace of a popular neighborhood in El Jadida at sunset, hugging her phone to her chest with a dreamy lovestruck smile, small cartoon hearts floating around her, laundry lines and satellite dishes in the background.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan street cafe terrace: AKRAM sits close to GIRL, laughing together over mint tea; NORA stands right next to their table, frozen in shock with her mouth open and her bag slipping from her shoulder; AKRAM turns his head and sees her, panicking. All faces clearly visible.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a narrow old-medina alley of El Jadida, NORA, furious with tears of anger, raises her hand to the sky as she swears revenge, fierce determined expression, dramatic evening light.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside the small apartment, AKRAM peeks nervously through a gap in the window curtains at the street below, sweating and scared, while REDOUANE in the background sips coffee and shakes his head, unimpressed.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: At the apartment front door, AKRAM with a backpack on his shoulder waves goodbye in a hurry, leaving for Casablanca; REDOUANE stands inside holding a black security guard cap, shrugging apologetically because he has to work.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Late morning in the small empty apartment, REDOUANE alone in the hallway freezes and stares at the closed front door with wide worried eyes, several dark shadows of feet visible in the light under the door, suspenseful atmosphere.
